title: Testcasesketch tests Validationrule
description: The test case checks that the security validation rule accepts or rejects a value, such as an input-validation test expecting a 400 or 422 for a malformed or oversized value. Use tests data-store.validationrule instead when the storage engine enforces the constraint.
x-dr-evidence: A test that sends a malformed, oversized or out-of-range value for one request field (an email, a redirect URL, a filename) and asserts HTTP 400/422 or the rule's violation message.
A unit test of a Bean Validation, Pydantic, Joi or Zod constraint (@Pattern, @Size, constr(regex=...)) on a security-sensitive DTO field.
